source: (1) MTC/SFCTA 2023 Bay Area Travel Study (BATS 2023) Consultant Final Report, Table 36; (2) SFMTA 2021 Travel Decisions Survey summary report; (3) SFMTA 2019 Travel Decisions Survey summary report; (4) SFMTA performance metric "Sustainable transportation mode share" (Transtat CSV)
period: BATS 2023: weekday travel, May 9 2023 - Jan 19 2024 (main fall wave Oct 2023 - Jan 2024). TDS 2021: May-Sep 2021. TDS 2019: May-Aug 2019.
notes: No SFMTA Travel Decision Survey newer than 2021 was found (SFMTA mode-share metric series ends FY 20-21). The most recent all-trip, SF-resident mode share found is BATS 2023, a regional household travel survey (8,258 households, SF oversampled).

IMPORTANT: BATS 2023 Table 36 is computed from UNLINKED trips (each leg separately; walk access/egress legs and transfers count as separate trips with purpose "Change mode"), as the report states. This inflates Walk and Transit trip counts relative to linked-trip mode shares. MTC said linked-trip results would follow (e.g. in SFCTA Downtown Travel Study); that SFCTA PDF (https://www.sfcta.org/sites/default/files/2025-05/Downtown_Travel_Study_Report_250513.pdf) could not be fetched (HTTP 403 to scripted download; >10MB to WebFetch).

TDS surveys are small telephone samples (2021: n=756 respondents, 470 SF residents; 2019: n=841) of Bay Area residents aged 18+, covering trips to/from/within SF; excludes visitors from outside the Bay Area, through trips and commercial trips. "All trips in SF" figures combine SF-resident and non-SF-resident trips assuming 73%/27% (SF-CHAMP). 2021 is during COVID; 2019 is pre-COVID. Values are published rounded to whole percent.
All numbers transcribed from text extracted from the PDFs (raw files kept); no values estimated.
